title: while Loop Counters (2 Stages)
description:
Practice writing while loops across 2 stages:
1. Create c1 = 1. Use a while loop to print c1 while c1 <= 3 (incrementing by 1 each step).
2. Create c2 = 3. Use a while loop to print c2 while c2 >= 1 (decrementing by 1 each step).
starter_code:
# Stage 1: Count UP 1 to 3 with while loop
c1 = 1


# Stage 2: Count DOWN 3 to 1 with while loop
c2 = 3
